text:
Anya: Huge thanks to @Marco and @Rina for rescuing the demo soundboard yesterday — you stayed late and rebuilt the route. Seriously saved the client call :trophy: :sparkles:
Marco: ahaha thanks! Rina found the missing header in 10 mins. I'm handing out virtual croissants :croissant:
Rina: croissant accepted. shoutout to @DevOps-bot for surface-level logs that pointed us in the right direction :robot_face:
DevOps-bot: alert: increased 500ms latency detected on /audio-mix at 2025-01-12T22:14:02Z. routed to oncall: Marco. :white_check_mark:
Leah: from CS: client emailed "amazed by the quick fix". small wins matter.
Anya: let's add a one-liner to the kudos doc: "Audio sherpas fixed routes + earned pastries". who wants an IRL pastry next week? :raising_hand:
Marco: I'm good for pastries. Rina?
Rina: yes pls. i'll take anything with chocolate. lastly, thanks team for pinging. felt calm and coordinated.
Leah: sending a tiny kudos token now. :sparkles:
Anya: Thanks all. Keeping these micro-shoutouts feels so much better than inboxes. :heart:
